functions.signature: int TesterCommHub::EngineSideHandler(const std::string& payload, void* ctx)

selected_notes: EngineSideHandler reads hub engine; null returns -1; OnHandlerMessage is wrapped in catch-all which increments handlerErrors_ and returns -1. Its engine-specific callee remains unread.
SelectTestType installs EngineSideHandler then calls thread Start; unchanged type returns engine/non-null and Running; factories and actual test-type consumers remain pending.

Thread Start sets Running before OS start; Loop separately attempts engine Start and clears Running/set StartFailed on failure. Start/SelectTestType local true cannot prove engine startup completed or device up.
Loop polls mailbox/RunOnce, counts exceptions, waits; on exit selected try block Poll precedes engine Stop. Exceptions and all caller/concurrency/OS contracts remain pending.
StopEngine clears engine-side handler, calls thread Stop, Reset and delete; local order is recorded, not global safety proof.
